name: posterior chain flexibility test
description: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.
